review_policy.close_only_when: Every acceptance command passes at the exact main commit and all non-code prerequisites are independently attested.

issues.objective: Retire each remaining exact architecture exception or reauthorize it without broadening the static-analysis boundary.
issues.scope_boundary: Python import edges represented by governance/architecture-contract.json; dynamic imports and whole-program data flow are not claimed.
issues.rollback: Restore the last passing exact edge set and its disposition; never widen an allowlist to make validation pass.

issues.objective: Resolve every repository-controllable comparative gap and classify non-code or excluded gaps without inflating capability claims.
issues.scope_boundary: Code-verifiable behavior only; packaging/release maturity and demonstrated real-world effectiveness are explicitly excluded.
issues.rollback: Revert unsupported code or claim changes together and restore the affected row to an explicit open disposition.

issues.objective: Continuously detect stale knowledge, dependency-lock drift, generated-document drift, and governance-evidence drift.
issues.scope_boundary: Repository-controlled static evidence; provider freshness requires separate authenticated capture.
issues.rollback: Revert the maintenance change, retain the failing evidence, and restore the last verified registry or lock.

issues.objective: Provide and attest one monitored private conduct-reporting destination distinct from vulnerability intake.
issues.scope_boundary: The repository can validate documentation and state transitions but cannot select, provision, or attest the owner's private destination.
issues.blocked_by: Repository owner must designate and attest a monitored private conduct-reporting destination.
issues.rollback: Remove an invalid destination and return the control to BLOCKED_OWNER_ACTION without exposing private reports.

issues.objective: Continuously certify CI, locked dependencies, immutable actions, source integrity, and rehearsable rollback.
issues.scope_boundary: Repository and GitHub control-plane evidence only; publication and downstream installation are separate release decisions.
issues.rollback: Restore the last certified workflow and dependency lock, then rehearse rollback in a disposable checkout before retrying.

issues.objective: Continuously preserve runtime, evidence binding, schema compatibility, generated reports, and certification receipts.
issues.scope_boundary: Deterministic repository artifacts and schemas; external truth and provider outcomes require separate evidence.
issues.rollback: Restore the last compatible schemas and evidence contract, regenerate only derived artifacts, and rerun exact-head certification.
